title: Bounce My Ball, Roll My Car
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ball, ball!
Here is my ball.
Ball, ball!
Bounce my little ball.

[Chorus]
Bounce, bounce, ball!
Roll, roll, car!
Bounce, bounce, ball!
Roll, roll, car!
Ball, ball!
Come and play with me.
Car, car!
Roll along with me.

[Verse 2]
Car, car!
Here is my car.
Car, car!
Roll my little car.

[Chorus]
Bounce, bounce, ball!
Roll, roll, car!
Bounce, bounce, ball!
Roll, roll, car!
Ball, ball!
Come and play with me.
Car, car!
Roll along with me.

[Playful echo]
Ball! Bounce, bounce!
Car! Roll, roll!
Ball! Bounce, bounce!
Car! Roll, roll!

[Final chorus]
Bounce, bounce, ball!
Roll, roll, car!
Bounce, bounce, ball!
Roll, roll, car!
Ball, ball!
Come and play with me.
Car, car!
Bye-bye, little car!
[Short resolved ending]
